text: 市场全天震荡调整，创业板指午后跌超2%。银行板块逆势走强，中国银行、工商银行、建设银行、中信银行股价创新高。传媒、影视股继续走强，新华传媒10连板，欢瑞世纪、博纳影业、慈文传媒均2连板。风电、光伏板块盘中拉升，首航新能、天顺风能、通达动力涨停。下跌方面，算力硬件股调整，金安国纪、华正新材等跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超4300股飘绿，今日成交1.55万亿。截止收盘沪指跌0.43%，深成指跌2.03%，创业板指跌2.61%。
text_en: The market fluctuated and adjusted throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index falling more than 2% in the afternoon. The banking sector strengthened against the trend, with Bank of China, ICBC, China Construction Bank, and CITIC Bank hitting new highs. Media and film stocks continued to strengthen, with Xinhua Media notching 10 consecutive limit-up days, while H&R Century, Bona Film Group, and Ciwen Media each recorded 2 consecutive limit-up days. Wind power and photovoltaic sectors surged during intraday trading, with Shouhang New Energy, Titan Wind Energy, and Tongda Power hitting the limit up. On the decline, computing power hardware stocks adjusted, with Jin'an Guoji and Huazheng New Material hitting the limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with over 4,300 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and today's turnover was 1.55 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.43%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.03%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.61%.
